---
title: "Table Comparison Diagnostic"
output: html_document
---

```{r compare}
library(sparklyr)
library(dplyr)
library(dbplyr)

sc <- spark_connect(method = "databricks")

p1_tbl <- tbl(sc, in_catalog("projects", "xx_drought_index", "drought_index_dailysummary"))
global_tbl <- tbl(sc, in_catalog("era5-daily-data", "silver_dev",
  "aer_era5_silver_approximate_1950_to_present_dev_interpolation_res5"))

# Argentina: row counts + date range + avg precip
p1_arg <- p1_tbl %>%
  filter(country == "Argentina") %>%
  summarise(
    source     = "phase1",
    n_rows     = n(),
    n_pixels   = n_distinct(x, y),
    avg_precip = mean(precip, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_year   = min(year),
    max_year   = max(year),
    x_min      = min(x),
    x_max      = max(x),
    y_min      = min(y),
    y_max      = max(y)
  ) %>%
  collect()

global_arg <- global_tbl %>%
  filter(country == "Argentina") %>%
  summarise(
    source     = "global",
    n_rows     = n(),
    n_pixels   = n_distinct(longitude, latitude),
    avg_precip = mean(sum_tp_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_year   = min(year(time)),
    max_year   = max(year(time)),
    x_min      = min(longitude),
    x_max      = max(longitude),
    y_min      = min(latitude),
    y_max      = max(latitude)
  ) %>%
  collect()

# Sample pixel spacing to infer resolution
p1_xvals <- p1_tbl %>%
  filter(country == "Argentina") %>%
  select(x) %>% distinct() %>% arrange(x) %>% head(5) %>% collect()

global_xvals <- global_tbl %>%
  filter(country == "Argentina") %>%
  select(longitude) %>% distinct() %>% arrange(longitude) %>% head(5) %>% collect()

# Sri Lanka existence check
lk <- global_tbl %>%
  filter(country %like% "%Lanka%") %>%
  summarise(
    source     = "global_lanka",
    n_rows     = n(),
    n_pixels   = n_distinct(longitude, latitude),
    avg_precip = mean(sum_tp_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  collect()

all_results <- list(
  p1_argentina    = p1_arg,
  global_argentina = global_arg,
  p1_x_sample    = p1_xvals,
  global_x_sample = global_xvals,
  sri_lanka       = lk
)

saveRDS(all_results, "/Volumes/projects/gwsc_drought/drought_outputs/diag_table_compare.rds")

cat("=== Phase 1 Argentina ===\n"); print(p1_arg)
cat("\n=== Global silver Argentina ===\n"); print(global_arg)
cat("\n=== Phase 1 x sample (resolution probe) ===\n"); print(p1_xvals)
cat("\n=== Global x sample (resolution probe) ===\n"); print(global_xvals)
cat("\n=== Sri Lanka ===\n"); print(lk)

spark_disconnect(sc)
```
